steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Is there really a fortress here that can shelter us from Catastrophes?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: There really is. Once our missions are over, I'll definitely show you all around~

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Are the golden carrots real, too?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: They really are. Although the name sounds weird, they taste delicious. The uncles and aunties back home even said they'd invite us over for dinner~

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Wow, a dinner party! Hehe, we'll have to ask Kroos to be our tour guide this time.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No problem~

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Don't let your guard down. Missions come first.

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: We know, Cap.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Alright, look sharp, everyone. Reserve Op Team A1, move out—
Let's go!
If we hadn't gone after those mercenaries smuggling medicine that night...
If we hadn't gone down into the mine that night...
If only... I could have seen more clearly that day.
'Kroos! Don't hesitate, now's the time!'
The battle lasted from sunset until late into the night.
Sweat kept seeping into Kroos's squinted eyes. She didn't have time to wipe it away, so she could only blink hard, trying her best to capture every detail in the darkness.
Don't blink! Kroos, keep your eyes peeled!
You can see clearly... You can definitely see clearly! You must see clearly—

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Lava, get back! Kroos, two o'clock!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Fang, watch your left!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Fang, your shoulder...

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Lava, lure them out of the mine! We can't let them detonate here!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I know!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Beagle, hold off that enemy with the gun!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Kroos, cover us!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (...What is that?)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (No, there's more than one! Behind us—)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Beagle, run! Don't look back—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Guys, don't look at me like that...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Kroos, the dark circles under your eyes...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Who could've predicted that would happen? We clearly gave it our all...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Tsk! Kroos, it's not your fault!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: You only did what you had to do. It was me... I failed to—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Fang! I-I'm really fine now...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: If you're really fine, you'd better not have trouble sleeping again tonight.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Beagle, not you too—

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: If it had been you at the back, Kroos, you would've done the same as me and tried your best to hold them off, right?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Besides... look, I'm perfectly fine. My physical fitness assessment score was 'Excellent', you know! I can still—

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hup!

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, don't move!
The red-haired girl, like a little spark, was itching to leap into action. But the moment she poked her head up, her friends pushed her back down onto the hospital bed.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Guys, I'm really fine...

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Lie down. A crossbow bolt pierced your arm, how could that be nothing?

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Fortunately, it didn't damage the bone, or things would have been much worse.
As those words fell, the ward, which had finally gained a bit of life, instantly grew cold again.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: (Quietly) Doctor...

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Ahem, fortunately, there weren't any major complications. But even so, Beagle, all your training is suspended for now, as are all other unnecessary activities. Just stay here and recover.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: No 'buts'. Fang, give this slip to Instructor Dobermann during training later. She'll understand.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Alright, let's give Beagle some peace and quiet to rest. And... Kroos, this mistake wasn't yours alone. Get some good sleep.

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: ...Everyone, get some good rest.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Heheh, then I can slack off with a clear conscience.
The ward fell empty once again, leaving Beagle all alone.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: If only, back then...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: (If only I had been a bit further to the right back then... If only my shield had been a bit thicker...)

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: (Then Kroos wouldn't be losing sleep... and everyone wouldn't be like this... I...)

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Beagle... when will you finally be able to truly raise that shield...

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Your vitals have returned to normal. Starting today, you can go out for a walk.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Thank you, doctor!

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Hmph, don't get ahead of yourself. I never said you could go back to the training room.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Eh...

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: However, some light rehab exercises are fine. Move your arms, stretch your legs—

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Remember, only moderate activity. If you feel any discomfort, or if your wound still hurts, let me know right away.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: It's so quiet... Maybe I should head over to the training room to check on everyone?
Stop it!!!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: —What is that?!

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Huff, huff...

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Beagle... please help—

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I'm on it!
The mischievous little beckbeast hopped onto the neatly stacked cardboard boxes in the hallway with a provocative look. It slowly raised its head and wagged its tail at the girl in front of it.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Here... Goldie, come here...
The petite girl leaned down slightly, trying to get the beckbeast's attention.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: (Beagle, I'm counting on you.)

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: (Slowly approaching)

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hah!
Accompanied by a pleasant purring sound, Beagle finally scooped the mischievous little beckbeast into her arms.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: I knew I could count on you, Senior!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Here. Be careful next time, and don't let it run around like that again.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Okay, Senior!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: And then...
The two girls looked in unison at the rows of cardboard boxes knocked over on the ground.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: These cardboard boxes... seem to have been temporarily left here by our colleagues from the Logistics Department...
In the corridor, scattered beckbeast paw prints stretched from where they stood all the way to the end of their line of sight.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: It's going to take some time to clean this all up...

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Ugh... I've caused you so much trouble, Senior, and you even treated me to a meal...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: We've been busy for so long that we missed lunchtime. Here, I only have bread.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Eat up. If you don't eat now, you'll be starving during training later.

steps.name: Reserve Operator
steps.text: Oh no! I still have training this afternoon—thanks again, Senior! I'll be going now!

steps.name: Commissary Staff
steps.text: Aren't you going to afternoon training, Beagle?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hehehe... I've actually requested leave from all the recent training sessions...

steps.name: Commissary Staff
steps.text: Is that so? Haha, it's rare to see you take leave. So, after hesitating for so long, have you decided which flavor you want for yourself?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hmm, there are so many new flavors, I've never even heard of them...

steps.name: Commissary Staff
steps.text: If you really can't decide, why not try this 'Rainforest Carnival' flavor?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Eh? The name sounds so strange...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: But since it's your recommendation, I'll take this one!

steps.name: Commissary Staff
steps.text: Alright. Oh, by the way—if you're not busy, could you help me deliver these boxes of snacks to Engineering, Beagle?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Of course, no problem!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Beagle, what are you doing here? Did you carry all these boxes... by yourself?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I happened to be free, so I helped carry them over! Whew, they're all here.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Then I'll be—
The girl's eyes unconsciously fell upon the shield leaning against the desk.
The shield's surface was clean and smooth, with unremoved support molds still hanging from its corners.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Want to give it a try? It's not finished yet, but we've incorporated a lot of new ideas into its design and materials.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Be careful, the weight hasn't been adjusted yet, so it might be a bit—

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: —Hah!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: ...heavy.
Beagle lifted the shield, swung it twice in the air, and then placed it steadily back on the ground.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: How does it feel?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: It fits perfectly! It's slightly lighter than my shield, but noticeably thicker. The handle position has also changed, making it much easier to change directions when using it!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: That's amazing...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Heh, it was well worth all the effort I put in lately.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: (If only I had been a bit further to the right back then... If only my shield had been a bit thicker...)

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Excuse me... Could I trouble you to modify my shield like this too, senior?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Eh? Of course, but—

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Do I need to apply to the head of the Engineering Department? Or should I report to Instructor Dobermann first?
Neither.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Mechanist?!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: This shield is still in the testing phase. We're still missing the most critical data, especially feedback from actual combat. So, if you want your shield modified like this, Beagle, you'll have to wait a bit longer.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I'm sorry, Mechanist, I was too impatient...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: However, if someone is willing to volunteer and work with the Engineering Operators to finish the testing early, we can definitely bring its production date forward significantly.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I'll help!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: And another thing—Beagle, this isn't the first time you've come to Engineering to request a shield modification, is it? I heard from Vulcan that you've already asked her to make your shield heavier many times.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: In that case, would you like to learn how to modify weapons yourself?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Yeah! If you do, you'll even be able to make all kinds of weapons yourself in the future.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Eh, me?! Can I really do it?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: You said before that to make a fine weapon, you need ideas, design, forging skills... not a single one can be missing. And you have to put in years of effort...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: At the very least, Beagle definitely doesn't lack the strength to forge weapons.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: As for Machina theory and the like, a diligent student like you will definitely have no problem learning it.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Is that so...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Yes, I understand! Thank you, senior, and thank you, Mechanist!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: This material isn't tough enough. Let's try another one.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Be careful to distinguish the properties of the two metals—this is key, so don't mix them up.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Little Beagle! The curvature of the shield has been readjusted! Come on, let's go to the clearing and test it out.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Coming!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Whoa, in less than a month, you made it this quickly? Let me see, this is... a shoulder plate?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Yes! I consulted the armor-making guide and tried to forge it.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: The general framework is correct, and the materials are quite suitable. But look here—with a gap this big, can it really provide any protection?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: There should be an optimization plan for the joints in the previous work notes. Why don't you go take a look?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Okay! I'll go right now!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Bea—Sigh, you don't have to go right this second. How long have you been working? You need to balance work and rest...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: The structure is finally correct this time.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: That's great...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Come on, grab your shoulder guards and shield, and we'll go to the clearing to test—

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Beagle?!!

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: What's going on? I clearly told her to get some proper rest and that she could do some light activity—whose idea of 'light activity' is staying up all night for over a month?!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: I didn't know...

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: You didn't know? It was all written in the diagnosis report. Did you not read it at all, or did you just not take it seriously?!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Ah... I saw it said that little Beagle could slowly start doing some rehabilitation training...

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: 'Rehabilitation training' means simple physical exercise to stretch her muscles and bones—not training her pain tolerance, and definitely not training to the point of fainting!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: That's only because little Beagle is usually so reliable, lifting such a heavy shield with ease... I'll definitely pay more attention next time!

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Next time?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Doctor, please calm down...

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: I'm not worked up! How am I worked up?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Doctor—Ah, Beagle, you're awake.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Ugh... Everyone, I...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Beagle, how are you feeling? Do you feel unwell anywhere else? You suddenly fainted right next to the console, you scared me to death!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I-I'm fine...
The girl slowly props herself up.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: ...I just feel a bit dizzy.

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: You actually realize you're dizzy? First cleaning the corridor, then running errands to move cargo, and then suddenly deciding to learn weapon manufacturing on a whim—tell me, what else have you been doing lately?!

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: What did I tell you before, huh? Rest more, rest! You're still injured, you can't—

steps.name: Medical Operator
steps.text: Mmph—let me finish, mmph—

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Alright, alright, that's enough. Can't you see they clearly have something to say... You're being so loud, they are completely stunned...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Beagle! I'm so glad you're okay!
The angry doctor was dragged and coaxed out by their colleague from Engineering, and the ward, which had been so noisy just a moment ago, suddenly fell silent.
The atmosphere was somewhat tense as the five of them looked at each other.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That pauldron, and that shield... Beagle, are you in such a hurry because of what happened that day?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Softly) Everyone, I'm sor...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: —I'm sorry! Everyone, it's my fault!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: It's my fault for making everyone worry... I—I just wanted to at least do something during this past month.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: What you should be doing most is resting and recovering with peace of mind. We're all waiting for you to come back.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: But even as our most level-headed captain... Fang, during this time, even you couldn't really have 'peace of mind', could you?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I secretly asked Instructor Grace. He said that Fang has been doing extra training until very, very late every night.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: But you have an injury on your shoulder too... Has the wound fully healed? Does it still hurt when you wake up in the middle of the night?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: And Kroos—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Eh? I'm doing great! You have no idea, Beagle, I got caught slacking off by Instructor Dobermann again yesterday. She gave me such a terrible scolding, it was super scary! Right, Hibiscus?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Eh? I-Is that so?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: But why do I feel like... you've been avoiding everyone lately?
The usually smiling Cautus girl uncharacteristically let her ears droop.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Kroos, you're still scared, aren't you?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: But aren't we all still standing right here by your side, safe and sound?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Tsk, not just now, but tomorrow, the day after—every single day in the future! We'll always be standing right by your side, safe and sound.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Little Lava?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Umm... Anyway, don't worry, I'm going to get super strong! Something like that will absolutely never happen again!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Pfft...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't laugh! When I say I'll do something, I mean it!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: So is little Lava going to start doing extra training starting tomorrow, just like Fang?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: But the doctor just said that training should be step-by-step, and we should only do what we can handle.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hearing that from Fang is not convincing at all!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Beagle—
Guilt, worry, self-doubt... These emotions still lingered around the girls, quietly magnifying whenever they were alone.
For some of them, that 'minor' mistake that day was like that stray arrow—piercing through their bodies, leaving a drafty void.
But when they gathered together, those negative emotions seemed to suddenly vanish, leaving only bickering, joking, and playful banter—
See? Today is a great day to meet up, too.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: ...Beagle.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Actually, I can guess what you're thinking.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Whether it was what happened on the battlefield that day, or what happened in Engineering today... these are all things you believe you can do, and that you feel in your heart you should do.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: So, no matter what we say, even if we say 'You should rest' or 'You shouldn't be doing this' a hundred or a thousand times, you'll still do it anyway, right?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: You say that because you also have things you're determined to do, right, Fang?
The young squad leader let out a heavy sigh, then said with absolute determination—

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Yes.
She looked at her squad members. Except for her, everyone had their heads down, none of them looking at each other. But she knew exactly what they were thinking—
Just like that night, just like on the battlefield... she knew exactly what choices her squad members would make when facing a crisis.
How could you hide your thoughts from your best friends? Everything was already understood.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: But, Beagle, if you firmly believe that doing something is right, you shouldn't apologize for your decision.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: ...To be honest, I was indeed very angry when I saw you collapse. But that anger was definitely not directed at you... so, you don't need to apologize to us.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: And as your friends, even if your decision is difficult and what you're going to do is dangerous... none of us have the right to tell you to give up.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Because everyone, in fact, has things they are determined to do.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Fang...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Fang is right—I think so too! So Beagle, you didn't let anyone down! And Kroos—you too!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: My, it's rare to get lectured by little Lava...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But I think if you didn't consider your friends' feelings at all when you did that—you should still apologize properly.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's just... Beagle, when you decide to do something, you can tell us openly and without worry.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: We might try to stop you from getting into danger, but what we'll do even more is work out a solution together, shoulder it together, and make sure nothing bad happens together!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Everyone...

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: So, Beagle, whether it's studying in Engineering or anything else you want to do... go ahead and do it.
Once the ice is broken, and someone steps forward to bravely say what everyone is thinking, the imagined awkwardness is replaced by genuine delight.
The girls, who were at a loss just moments ago, hug each other tightly.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Ahem. Dobermann, it seems we've come at a bad time.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Instructor Grace, Instructor Dobermann!

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: So, can you put your mind at ease now?

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Beagle, don't stay up so late in Engineering next time. Dobermann was so worried just now that she—

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Your current condition is not suitable for work and training, so take a good rest for a while longer. If you're really in a hurry, you can make up for the missed training later.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Ah?!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Yes, Instructor Dobermann!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Kroos, I have missions for you. Keep a close eye on Beagle for the time being and make sure she gets plenty of rest... and that goes for you, too.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Fang, Hibiscus, and Lava, the three of you need to come to the training room first thing tomorrow morning. Engineering just sent over a new batch of protective gear that urgently needs field testing.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Mechanist said that production on this batch of protective gear was moved up by a whole week, so I had no choice but to call the three of you in to help.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I still have things to take care of at the training room, so I'll be off now.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: As swift and decisive as ever... Beagle, get some good rest. The reserve operators are still waiting for you to give them a demonstration!
Dobermann's footsteps suddenly stop at the door. She turns back to look at the girl on the hospital bed.
Laughter and playful banter echo from the ward.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: So, it's decided then? You're going to let Beagle learn a thing or two from Engineering?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: She has raised many shields, and she will find the one that suits her best... Just as she will find the perfect shields for her comrades.

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Whoa, slow down, slow down—

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: Sigh... Then I also hope that little Beagle, Fang, and the others... can take their time growing up behind that sturdy shield.
